title: To someone truly exceptional
excerpt: A tribute to Mercy, honoring her intelligence, wisdom, and the meaningful connection built through friendship and shared work.
body:
Mercy (Mihret Tsegaye) is one of the greatest women I have ever met. When I think of someone who has both intelligence and beauty, she is the first person that comes to mind. She is logical, but at the same time, she still keeps her human emotions, feelings, and sense of connection.

Often, we don’t really notice how good our friends or partners are at certain things. Even if we laugh together and share many coffees, we may not fully understand their emotional and intellectual depth. But from the first moment I saw her, I noticed a fire in her eyes—a strong desire for wisdom and knowledge. It is a passion that goes beyond what she learned from school or family.

We have worked together on different projects, especially in technology. When we built this website, it was not our first project, and it will not be the last. During all this time, I have always been impressed by how quickly she understands what I want and even what I am about to say.

So, I decided to dedicate the first insight of this website to Mercy. I want to thank her and also let others know how great she is and how happy I am to know her.

She is not just a partner or a friend. She is a blessing.

title: Now Ready
excerpt: Karamon – Pigeon and Falcon is now printed and ready for release. It will soon be available in bookstores.
body:
ካራሞን - ዋኖስ እና ጭልፊት
አዲስ መጽሐፍ ከአዛርየስ ደሴ

ካራሞን የህትመት ሂደቱን ጨርሶ ከማተሚያ ቤት ወጥቷል። በቅርቡ ለመጽሐፍት ቤቶች የምናከፋፍል ይሆናል። ይህ እንዲሆን የደከማችሁና አብራችሁን የነበራችሁ ሁሉ ገለታ ለእናንተ!

ብዙ አዲስ ነገሮች ይኖሩናል። የድርሠት ሥራ ላይ ላላችሁ፣ በመጽሐፍ ሽያጭ እና ህትመት ላይ ለተሰማራችሁ ሁሉ የሚጠቅሙ አዳዲስ ሙከራዎችንም ይዘን መጥተናል። ወደ እያንዳንዳችሁ እጅ እንዲደርስ እየተመኘን ጥሩ ንባብ እንደሚኖራችሁ ከወዲሁ የተወደደ ቃላችንን እንሰጣለን።

አዛርየስ ደሴ
አዲስ አበባ፣ ኢትዮጵያ

Karamon – Pigeon and Falcon
New Book by Azaries Dessie

Karamon has completed the printing process and is now ready for release. Soon, it will be distributed to bookstores.

We would like to thank everyone who participated and supported this project.

We also have many new initiatives that will help both novel writers and people in the publishing industry. We hope this book will soon be in your hands, and we are confident that you will love it.

Azaries Dessie
Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

title: Book Launch Event
excerpt: <Karamon - Pigeon and Falcon> was officially launched.
body:
በዕለተ ማክሰኞ፣ ግንቦት 18፣ 2018 ዓ.ም፣  ከምሽቱ 12:00 ጀምሮ <ካራሞን - ዋኖስ እና ጭልፊት> መጽሐፍ በደማቅ ሁኔታ ይፋ ተደርጓል። በርካታ ሜዲያ እና ስመ ጥር ባለሙያዎች የተገኙ ሲሆን፣ በሚቀጥሉት ሁለት ቀናት መጽሐፉ ለመጻሕፍት መደብሮች የሚከፋፈል ይሆናል።

ፕሮግራሙ እዚያው የተሳሉ አሁናዊ ሥዕሎችን፣ ጋዜጣዊ መግለጫ፣ የፊርማ ሥነ ሥርዐት እና የእራት ፕሮግራምን ያካተተ ነው።

Tue, May 26, at 6:00 PM (12:00 LT), <Karamon - Pigeon and Falcon> was officially launched. Media representatives and influencers attended the event, and the book will be distributed within the next two days.

The program featured a live painting performance, a press conference, a book signing session, and a dinner reception.
